name: pdfluent-hosted
description: PDFluent Extract API and PDFluent PDF API as MCP tools, on one key and one credit balance: PDF to markdown, tables and chunks, plus convert, merge, split, compress, redact, forms, PDF/A, OCR and barcodes. Documents are sent to api.pdfluent.com; calls are paid in prepaid credits.

api_key.title: PDFluent API key
api_key.description: Create a key in the PDFluent console at pdfluent.com. It is sent to api.pdfluent.com as the x-api-key header and stored in your system keychain.
